segments.text: That the ſame power that converts to faith in Chriſt, the ſame power carries on the ſoule ſtill through all duties, temptations, conflicts, ſufferings, and continually what ever a Chriſtian is, he is by grace, and by a conſtant renewed operation from God, without which he cannot performe any dutie to God, or undergoe any temptations from Satan, the world, or men.
